ecom-daily-report v1.0.0

- Initial release of "直播电商日报" Skill.
- Supports daily collection and structuring of live e-commerce industry news across five key directions.
- Dual input modes: automatic online search and manual content summarization.
- Outputs structured daily reports in Markdown; saves files locally.
- Designed for投手、运营、商家 and compatible with WorkBuddy, ClawHub, and similar AI tools.
